corpus=0 · new_closed=0 · win_rate=n/a · calibration=identity.

The Learning Engine's job is to close the feedback loop: match each closed recommendation to its outcome, compute feature/model attribution, cluster failures, and fit a calibration curve. It does NOT modify the recommendation engine. Every proposal (deprecation candidates, calibration updates) routes through the Promotion Gate for operator approval.

findings.note: no historical outcomes yet — the learning corpus populates as recommendations close their 60-day horizons OR as Sprint 8 walk-forward generates historical closes. This is honest, not broken.
findings.next_step_hint: Sprint 8 walk-forward will generate historical closes at scale.

caveats: corpus < 30 → attributions are directional, not statistically robust
